title: Neural Dynamics
purpose: A proposed course in the Corniversity catalogue (Optional advanced elective). Dynamical descriptions of neural activity, stability, population dynamics and their relationship to computational models, coordinated with computational neuroscience and the mathematics department's dynamical-systems material.
description: Proposed course: Neural Dynamics. Central question: How do dynamical descriptions explain the activity of neural populations?
